sql.query: UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts gc SET gc.contractName=:contractName,gc.renderedHtml=:renderedHtml,gc.rowVersion=gc.rowVersion+1,gc.draftModifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,gc.draftModifiedByUserId=:userId,gc.modifiedByUserId=:userId2,gc.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status='draft' AND gc.rowVersion=:rowVersion AND NULLIF(TRIM(:nameCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:htmlCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.drafts.edit' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)

SELECT gc.id,gc.status,gc.rowVersion,gc.draftModifiedDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown user') draftModifiedByUserName FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=gc.draftModifiedByUserId WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1
